rules.title: Still have your old passport?
rules.text: You can usually travel on your new passport with a valid e-Visa issued on the old one, as long as you carry both passports.

rules.title: Lost or stolen passport
rules.text: If you no longer have the old passport, transfer the e-Visa to your new one before you travel.

rules.title: Details must match
rules.text: Your name, date of birth and nationality must be the same on both passports. If they’ve changed, call us first.

sections.heading: How to transfer an Indian e-Visa to a new passport
sections.text: India’s e-Visa portal now offers a service to move a valid e-Visa from an old passport to a new one. You give the old passport and e-Visa details and upload your new passport. With us, you upload your new passport and current e-Visa, and we check whether a transfer is needed before we submit it.

sections.heading: When should I move my Indian e-Visa to a new passport?
sections.text: If your old passport was lost or stolen, or you no longer have it, transfer your Indian e-Visa to a new passport before you travel. If you still have the old passport, you can usually travel with both passports instead, which is simpler.

faqs.q: I renewed my passport. Is my Indian e-Visa still valid?
faqs.a: Yes, if it hasn’t expired. Carry your old passport with the e-Visa together with your new passport. If the old one is lost, transfer the e-Visa.

faqs.q: Can I transfer a 30-day e-Tourist visa?
faqs.a: It’s usually simpler to apply for a new one. We’ll check your case.

faqs.q: Can I apply myself instead of using you?
faqs.a: Yes. You can apply on the official website, indianvisaonline.gov.in, and pay only the government fee. People use us when they want a person to check their eligibility, fix their photo and documents, and handle the form for them so nothing goes wrong.
